title: A Choir for the Hymn
author: Petra Underhill
blurb: Dominic Dravenmoor, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
